title: Comments
description:
Comments are how you add, well, comments to your code. You make a single line comment by typing '`//`'. That makes all text on this line past `//` a comment. Meanwhile, multiline comments you make with the syntax`/* text */`. All text and all lines past /* is a comment until */.
## Assignment:
Another **_[REDACTED]_** From the TechQ team _accidently_ commented out the code and forgot to close a multi line comment! Fix it.
hint: Remember: You close multi line comments with `*/`
